purpose: Complete the same unmodified validator with all 38 LunarLander replays under explicitly limited numerical-library threading. The default-thread run-b is retained separately. This does not replace run-b or relax its acceptance criteria.
basis: The default environment exposes nine PyTorch threads. The first DQN replay took 354.46 seconds of evaluation. A separate one-thread replay took 9.48 seconds and reproduced identical compared episode records, aggregate statistics and the same blocking aggregate-disagreement.
benchmark_claim: These are diagnostic observations during overlapping jobs, not controlled performance estimates.
